degeneracy_mode_not_caught.name: manipulation_inert (distinct from revisit_degenerate)
degeneracy_mode_not_caught.description: The run's revisit_population_non_degenerate precondition (red-team F2's fix on this driver) tests that TOTAL REVISIT COUNT is non-zero in both arms. All three pooled seeds pass it (31, 55, 288). It cannot see a seed whose revisit counts are non-zero AND IDENTICAL ACROSS ARMS -- a structural zero in a DIFFERENCE DV arriving through a door the count-based test does not cover.
degeneracy_mode_not_caught.consequence: The load-bearing criterion calibration_population_adequate (measured 3.0, threshold 1.5) PASSED legitimately on its own terms but does NOT certify what it was written to certify -- that there is a population to characterise a DV range over.
degeneracy_mode_not_caught.correct_remedy: NOT a new outcome-denominated precondition (that would select on the outcome and inflate the bar by construction). The correct remedy is to APPLY 983a's two existing, ratified, outcome-INDEPENDENT screens.

targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-1036 (EXT-002 lineage stage 2a) set out to bank a revisit-rate DV range on 3 freshly-drawn completion-gate survivors. Its load-bearing criterion passed legitimately but certifies population SIZE only. 2 of the 3 pooled seeds produced BIT-IDENTICAL revisit streams across A0_INTACT and A1_RESIDUE_FROZEN (31 vs 31; 55 vs 55), so decline_rate_gap is exactly 0.0 on both and every banked gap statistic is a deterministic function of the single remaining seed -- EFFECTIVE n = 1. The fallback control-arm statistic is NOT an alternative: its range endpoints are precisely those two zero-gap seeds. NO stage-2 threshold is derivable from this run. Both zero-gap seeds' action-stream divergence (0.00138, 0.00323) sits inside 983a's own 'did not reach executed behaviour' bucket, and 983a's ratified P7 heterogeneity floor (0.10) would have rejected all ten cells (max 0.0909). Run was cleared as reviewed before this adjudication existed.

learning_extracted: For any A-minus-B DIFFERENCE DV, a non-degeneracy precondition denominated on PER-ARM event counts cannot see a cell whose counts are non-zero but identical across arms. The test must be denominated on the DIFFERENCE, or on an outcome-INDEPENDENT per-arm screen such as 983a's revisit_outcome_heterogeneity.

A precondition denominated on the DV's own value (e.g. 'require gap != 0') is selection on the outcome and inflates any threshold banked from the survivors. When a screen is needed for a calibration run, it must be outcome-independent.
A calibration run that banks a range should report the EFFECTIVE n of that range alongside the pooled-seed count. Here they differed by 3x and only the pooled-seed count reached the criteria block.

When a range statistic is offered as a fallback bar, check WHICH cells define its endpoints. Here the 'control-arm' fallback was defined entirely by the two cells the primary finding had just condemned -- a failure mode invisible to any check that reads only the aggregate.

DROPPED HANDOFF: 983a's confirmed autopsy recommended the successor gate per seed on divergence > 0. The successor declined on a calibration-vs-evidence-run distinction, and the precise defect that gate prevents then occurred. A prior autopsy's recommendation declined by a successor deserves an explicit, recorded justification in the successor's docstring that engages the specific failure mode, not a category distinction.

The ratified screen that would have caught this ALREADY EXISTED and was already coded (FLOOR_REVISIT_HETEROGENEITY = 0.10). Before recommending a new precondition, check whether the lineage already ratified one.
targets.routing_note: USER-CONFIRMED at the Step 8 gate (2026-09-17): the stage-2 evidence run must apply the two screens 983a ALREADY RATIFIED rather than inventing a new precondition -- (a) revisit_outcome_heterogeneity >= FLOOR_REVISIT_HETEROGENEITY (0.10), the ratified PreconditionSpec at v3_exq_983a...py:614; (b) per-seed action-stream divergence > 0, per 983a autopsy learning #4. Both are outcome-independent, both are already in code. NO threshold is to be taken from V3-EXQ-1036 by any route, including the control-arm statistic. Raising the draw target alone is explicitly NOT sufficient: the ratified screens would have rejected all five draws, so a larger draw under the same screening would mostly add rejected seeds.
